correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed for every permitted permutation and every \(n\ge k+2\). A concrete competitor gives \(V_n\le2^{3-n}/3\). Every early merged adjacent pair contributes at least that scale by an exact two-point variance formula and the dyadic weight structure. Even in the equality cases, total distortion is strictly larger because infinitely many positive-mass support atoms cannot all coincide with finitely many representatives. Consecutive cells and the centroid property then force the claimed singleton cells and representatives.
